evidence.detail: rs/n/d owns the static List<rs/n/c> master collection plus the shared TextDrawingArea[] font array used for custom interface construction.
Its initialization path clears the list, installs the shared fonts and explicitly constructs/registers the full rs/n/c/* custom-interface catalogue one builder at a time.
The central add method accepts exactly rs/n/c CustomInterfaceBuilder instances; the registry subsequently drives builder setup/build lifecycle over that collection.

The same initialization path resets custom widget helpers and is invoked from the interface-loading subsystem, placing this class at the composition/registry layer above individual RSInterface builders.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the registry/composition root of the custom-interface builder catalogue.

evidence.detail: rs/n/c is abstract, extends R56 RSInterface, stores the shared TextDrawingArea[] font set, and defines the abstract no-arg build method implemented by the concrete custom-interface classes.

Dozens of already-reviewed rs/n/c/* classes extend this base and build named SpawnPK custom interfaces such as Blood Diamond Fuser, Blood Fountain perk tree, raids, teleports, confirmation, mailbox, trading post and construction screens.
rs/n/d stores List<rs/n/c>, constructs the concrete builder catalogue with the same shared font array and registers each instance through its rs/n/c-typed add method.

The base also exposes default no-op int/String and int hooks, a no-op lifecycle method, and a default true predicate for concrete builders to override where needed, fixing it as shared builder/lifecycle infrastructure rather than a specific widget definition.

proposals.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the abstract base of the SpawnPK custom-interface construction family.
